name: Ward L. Lambert Fieldhouse and Gymnasium

source_references.retrieved: 2026-10-24 (source snapshot already present in the project)
source_references.source_crs: WGS84 geographic coordinates; converted using the project's documented local approximate conversion
source_references.use: 20-edge current GIS outline and local plan registration; it does not identify the internal hall/gym allocation or verify height, roof, facade, or interior.

source_references.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections, Purdue Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database
source_references.use: Supports one-story 303 x 172 ft fieldhouse and separate four-story 210 x 110 ft gym; dimensions converted with 0.3048 m/ft. It does not georeference either volume or measure elevations, floor-to-floor heights, roof profile, or present tower status.
Current identity and use as home of Purdue track and field; official description supports the six-lane 200 m track.

source_references.provider: Dave Wegiel Photography, Gene Edmonds Invitational at Lambert Fieldhouse
source_references.use: Interior visual context for track, seating, the arched steel roof and competition-event equipment. It is not measured documentation.

source_references.provider: Boston Public Library Tichnor Brothers postcard collection, via Wikimedia Commons
source_references.use: Historical material and massing context only. The postcard documents a past tower, but current survival is unverified and the tower conjecture is omitted from the R9 export.

registration_recheck.placement_status: The GIS polygon and track dimensions are retained. Archival volume dimensions match the built geometry within the listed conversion, but the archive does not register the two volumes against the U-shaped GIS polygon. Hall/gym allocation and their relative placement remain an illustrative, unverified hypothesis. No source provides measured elevations.

changes_since_round8: Assigned a material to each of the 24 previously unassigned event hurdle meshes: all 24 crossbar/upright/foot components now have either the existing painted crossbar material or the new dark steel upright/foot material.
Removed the detached GIS-derived stone-band mesh and the GIS-edge horizontal datum segments whose path extends through the outline's unbuilt/notched portions.
Removed the unsupported south clerestory strip and the detached north wall-banner plus gold-stripe row (14 objects) beyond the supported footprint and archival fieldhouse envelope.

Removed the 22 previously hidden historic entrance-tower conjecture objects from the export; sources do not confirm current survival, location, or dimensions. This also removed their invalid negative-Z extent from the active asset bounds.

Removed the 98 m Stadium Avenue sidewalk, curb, and roadway meshes from the building export. They are site-context geometry and should be supplied by the coordinator/master if needed, not duplicated with this building asset.

Added meter-scale procedural color variation and subtle bump relief to brick, roof membrane, concrete, limestone, asphalt, track, and gym glazing. Retained the packed R8 brick image texture; all material dependencies are internal to the blend.

Reframed the exterior and both interior/event review cameras. Interior images are cutaway evidence renders with shell, roof, unrelated gym layers, and review-only context hidden temporarily; all original visibility flags are restored before the file is saved.
source_limitations: No available source georeferences the archival hall/gym rectangles to the current GIS footprint; this remains an unresolved registration issue.

No available source provides surveyed elevations, floor-to-floor dimensions, current roof curvature or ridge/eave heights, truss spacing, facade bay measurements, or confirms survival of the historic entrance tower.
Event fixtures, interior seating layout, gym interior, and the four-story gym elevation remain schematic/estimated; the track is verified by official source identity and model centerline measurement.
The historic and contemporary image sources are visual references only. The GIS JSON snapshot is retained locally; the web pages are cited but not archived as raw HTML in this revision.

coordinator_integration.master_instance_transform: No changes; preserve current Placement_<building_id> marker and manifest placement.
coordinator_integration.site_context: Do not import the removed Stadium Avenue sidewalk/curb/road from this building asset; coordinator may use shared master/context geometry if needed.
